name: Gardens of Eden - Park Residences
location: Bang Tao (Pa Sak / Choeng Thale, Thalang)
shortDescription: Park Residences is the second residential phase of the Gardens of Eden master development by Amal Group, a large low-density resort community in Bang Tao on Phu
description: Park Residences is the second residential phase of the Gardens of Eden master development by Amal Group, a large low-density resort community in Bang Tao on Phuket's west coast. It is described as 455 condominium units in seven-storey buildings, from one to three bedrooms, set within a landscaped community with parks and lakes. The development is marketed in collaboration with Etro, and residents share the master community's wellness, pool and leisure facilities.
paymentPlan: Agent listing shows 35% payable over 1 year, remainder on completion (unit-level terms to be confirmed with the developer)
For reference only, Phase 1 Eden Residences schedule: THB 100,000 reservation, 35% on contract, 15% building permit, 10% foundation, 15% structure, 15% interior finishing, 10% on transfer

researchNotes: Identity: 'Gardens of Eden' is the name of the whole Amal Group master development (about 73 rai per official site/agents; other sources say 33-35 acres), planned in three residential phases plus Etro-branded residences: Phase 1 Eden Residences (127 units per agent; some sources 141; Q4 2026 completion, roughly 80% sold per press in 2024), Phase 2 Park Residences (455 units; Q4 2027), Phase 3 Lake Residences (698 units; off-plan, completion sources conflict Q3 2028 / Q2 2029). Park Residences was chosen as the sellable phase because it has current advertised prices and is under construction, whereas Eden Residences is largely sold and Lake Residences is off-plan. The official site gives no prices or phase data. Park Residences unit listing shows 'floor 1-7'; bathrooms per unit were assumed equal to listed counts (1BR 1, 2BR 2, 3BR 3). Community facilities and land area are master-community figures, not Park-only. Exact coordinates, fees, and reservation terms not found. Total of 1,280 residences quoted by one source across phases. | Lowest advertised Park Residences price is the 56 sqm one-bedroom (Papaya Property, read 2026-11-14). The developer site publishes no prices. Other phases are priced differently (Eden Residences from THB 22.5M; Lake Residences 1BR 52 sqm from THB 11,904,800), so do not mix them.
